description: One explicit tool per Bodhan model, plus local media conversion.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe a local PCM WAV with Indic-Transcribe. Estimates duration in dry run, chunks long audio internally, and merges transcript segments.

tools.name: translate_text
tools.description: Translate text to a supported language using Indic-Translate.

tools.name: transliterate_text
tools.description: Convert text between native and roman scripts without changing language using Indic-Transliterate.

tools.name: synthesize_speech
tools.description: Generate spoken audio from text using Indic-Speak. Splits long text internally and merges WAV chunks into one artifact.

tools.name: ocr_document
tools.description: Extract text and layout from an image using Indic-OCR.

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_images
tools.description: Convert local PDF pages to image files without calling a paid model.

tools.name: chunk_audio
tools.description: Split WAV locally at fixed durations or use smart_chunking=true for frame-energy VAD boundaries; returns paths and offsets.

tools.name: transcribe_video
tools.description: Extract audio from a local video and transcribe it with Indic-Transcribe.

tools.name: extract_video_audio
tools.description: Extract a video audio stream to a local normalized WAV without a paid API call.

tools.name: replace_video_audio_track
tools.description: Create a video copy with a supplied audio track, handling duration mismatch locally.

description: Fine-grained operations expose chunking and page handling to the agent.

tools.name: inspect_audio
tools.description: Return duration, sample rate, channels, and format for a local audio file.

tools.name: chunk_audio
tools.description: Split WAV into API-safe chunks; smart_chunking optionally uses frame-energy VAD near silence.

tools.name: transcribe_audio_chunk
tools.description: Transcribe one short audio chunk; caller is responsible for merging segments.

tools.name: translate_segment
tools.description: Translate a single text segment; caller is responsible for preserving order and completeness.

tools.name: render_speech_chunk
tools.description: Synthesize one short text chunk and return a local audio artifact path.

tools.name: extract_pdf_pages
tools.description: Render PDF pages to image files and return paths in page order.

tools.name: ocr_image
tools.description: Extract text and layout from one page image.

description: Higher-level task tools perform common multi-step jobs with limited planner control.

tools.name: translate_audio_file
tools.description: Transcribe an audio file and translate the transcript to a requested supported language.

tools.name: translate_scanned_document
tools.description: OCR a scanned document and translate its contents while preserving page order.

tools.name: create_spoken_summary
tools.description: Extract text from a document, create a summary in a requested supported Indic language, synthesize it, and return text and audio artifacts.

tools.name: transcribe_video
tools.description: Transcribe the audio track from a local video.

tools.name: translate_video
tools.description: Estimate costs, transcribe and translate video speech, select the closest catalog voice using local DSP reference embeddings, synthesize translated speech, and replace the video's audio track.
